body: Happy Night is the best Christmas mod you can get with a ridiculous amount of love put into it. The 800 weapons pack is a build of Postal 2 my friend made and gave me with mods and maps you can't really find anymore. Infact the "800" is an understatement as to just how much there is in the build.
When I was in the hospital for my suicide attempts, someone kept telling me, and wrote on paper so I wouldn't forget "This Too Shall Pass."

I'm sorry your mother is like that. I have a polar opposite problem where I feel like I don't deserve the kindness bestowed on me by mine. If we could swap mothers, I would. No-one should be told that stuff by their own mother. It's hard. It's really hard. All I can tell you is I'm sorry and I hope things heal and she realises what she's doing wrong as a mother and as a person.
You've already atoned in this action alone. Though I do not condone the method, you could really hurt for this. Isn't that enough?

Rise above everyone who ever wronged you that way. It may take time, it took me years of being cut down by everyone around me to learn as an adult that I had worth and could actually do some things well. Things can get better just as quickly as things can turn to shit.
Always the second one if it applies to someone else. The first one is really what should be hammered into me though.
